Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that the Board of Directors of Monocon International Refractories Limited (MIRL), United Kingdom, a Material Subsidiary of the Company, at their meeting held on 26th November, 2026, have approved elevation of Mr Dheeraj Parakh to the post of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of MIRL effective 1st December, 2026. Mr Parakh hitherto is holding the post of Finance Director of MIRL and associated with MIRL since 2006, possessing over 20 years of extensive hands-on experience of being involved in operations of MIRL Mr Manoj Rakhecha, currently CEO of MIRL, will cease to hold said post from 1st December, 2026 but will continue as a Director of MIRL and responsible for sales and other related matters of MIRL.
